scope: Same Apple M1/macOS loopback AOT Serve fixture, ten-byte body, one request/connection, 16 server lanes, 64 client slots. No builds or profilers during timed runs.
followup: If paced 150 passes both trials, test 200 with two 60-second trials; if it fails, test 100 with two 120-second trials. Retain every result. Inspect per-second bursts and first/last RSS, not just aggregates. A passing point is a local tested operating point, never a universal maximum or production capacity.
memory: Report sampled first/last/peak RSS and first/last ten-second medians; stable RSS over these windows is not a leak proof.
rationale: 64 client slots allow brief bursts to queue rather than hiding them behind the former 16-slot cap. Offered latency includes generator lateness and all misses remain failures. Shared-host pauses are a qualification limitation, not discarded outliers.
